assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one low fidelity Crazy 8 concept sketch for an Indonesian university UX report, not a polished production app.
Primary request: Draw ONE distinct concept, a contextual bottom sheet opened inside the canonical Detail Pesanan surface of Fleffy, a shoe laundry cashier application. Portrait 3:4 composition, visual proportions equivalent to a 390 x 520 mobile viewport. Black, white and neutral gray only. Deliberately simple slightly hand drawn straight lines, rectangular boxes, clear printed Indonesian text, abundant whitespace. No blue, no color, no device bezel, no operating system bar, no phone frame, no giant branding, no option number, no collage.
Input image: Image 1 is context reference only about payment recording vs bank receipt. Do not copy its colors, amounts, layout or its Rp57.000 example.
Composition: In the upper background show the compact title "Detail Pesanan", then "PSN-015", "Bank Transfer", "Rp150.000". Beneath show "Pembayaran tercatat" and the small clarification "Bukan konfirmasi dana masuk". A partially obscured simple "Bukti pelanggan" box implies the underlying order detail. The bottom half has one clearly open bottom sheet with a drag handle and a top-right X close control. Sheet title "Pemeriksaan". Inside the sheet show "Hasil belum tersedia", "Pemeriksa: Owner", then a simple outlined action "Lihat permintaan" and a small text action "Panduan menunggu". At the bottom of the sheet, a light gray clearly inactive button "Teruskan" and its visible explanation "Menunggu hasil pemeriksa". Footer small "Data ilustrasi".
Interaction meaning: Closing the sheet returns to the SAME order detail, not another new page. Payment is recorded but receipt is NOT confirmed; a request already exists. This is a pending state.
Constraints: Never show result as received, verified, paid-confirmed, success or adequate while pending. No extra request button, no checkbank button, no bank API, no timer or ETA, no Ari bank access. Do not show a checked receipt icon. Keep only the exact elements above, very legible and sparse. Use normal Indonesian lettering with correct spacing and clean punctuation.
assets.inspection: Text correct; open contextual panel; pending result clearly visible; gray disabled Teruskan with reason. Copy only, no crop/edit.

assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one low fidelity Crazy 8 concept sketch for an Indonesian university UX report, not a polished production app.
Primary request: Draw ONE distinct concept, an order check queue with the selected order's canonical detail surface immediately underneath. Fleffy shoe laundry application. Portrait 3:4 composition, visual proportions equivalent to a 390 x 520 mobile viewport. Black, white and neutral gray only. Simple slightly hand drawn lines and boxes, legible printed Indonesian text, generous whitespace, minimal information.
Input image: Image 1 is payment context reference only. Do not copy its colors, its Rp57.000 amount, or its layout.
Composition: Top header "Pemeriksaan Pembayaran". Compact search input "Cari ID pesanan". Under that, one compact filter pill "Menunggu hasil". Then two minimal order rows: first "PSN-015" left and "Rp150.000" right, subtitle "Terpilih • Menunggu hasil"; give this first row bold border and light gray fill so selection is unmistakable. Second row "PSN-016" left and "Rp150.000" right, subtitle "Menunggu hasil"; no selected styling. A clear separator. Lower half header "Detail Pesanan • PSN-015". Then "Bank Transfer" and "Rp150.000". Small text "Pembayaran tercatat" and "Bukan konfirmasi dana masuk". Below show "Hasil belum tersedia" and "Pemeriksa: Owner". An outlined action "Lihat permintaan". A light gray inactive button "Teruskan", explanation "Menunggu hasil pemeriksa". Small footer "Data ilustrasi".
Interaction meaning: selecting PSN-015 opens the SAME canonical N1b Detail Pesanan surface, shown below the queue context, not duplicated separate order pages. Request for PSN-015 already exists. Identical nominal values on two orders intentionally demonstrate why order ID is essential.
Constraints: Do not add a phone/device bezel, OS chrome, logo, option number, extra cards, tabs, timestamp, ETA, bankcheck button, bank API, success, result confirmed, request-new button, or an extra 'Teruskan' anywhere. Never imply recorded payment guarantees receipt; pending state must be clear. Keep it simple enough that text is readable at a small report sketch size. No cropped elements or text.
assets.inspection: Selected PSN-015 explicit; PSN-016 same amount distinct ID; pending result clearly visible; no additional request action; gray disabled Teruskan. Copy only, no crop/edit.
